```{r}
required_packages <- c(
  "edgeR",
  "limma",

  "tidyr",

    required_packages,
    requireNamespace,
    logical(1),
    quietly = TRUE
  )

  stop(
    "The following packages are required but not installed: ",
```

```{r}
params <- list(
  crc_clinical_file =
    "data/clinical_data.csv",

  crc_mirna_file =
    "data/coad/miRNA_counts_matrix.csv",

  ucec_clinical_file =
    "data/ucec_clinical.csv",

  ucec_mirna_file =
    "data/ucec/miRNA_counts_matrix.csv",

  output_root =
    "data/DE_results/pre_miRNA/separate_analysis",

  figure_root =
    "results/figures/pre_miRNA/separate_analysis",

  fdr_cutoff = 0.05,
  logfc_cutoff = 1,
  min_count = 5,
  volcano_label_n = 10
)

fs::dir_create(params$output_root)
fs::dir_create(params$figure_root)

group_colors <- c(
  "MSI-H" = "#7AA6DC",
  "MSS/TMB-H" = "#A73030",
  "MSS/TMB-L" = "#868686"
)
```

```{r}
standardize_msi_tmb <- function(x) {
  mapping <- c(
    "MSI-H" = "MSI-H",
    "MSI_H" = "MSI-H",
    "MSS/TMB-H" = "MSS/TMB-H",
    "MSS_TMB_H" = "MSS/TMB-H",
    "MSS/TMB-L" = "MSS/TMB-L",
    "MSS_TMB_L" = "MSS/TMB-L"
  )

  factor(
    unname(mapping[as.character(x)]),
    levels = c(
      "MSI-H",
      "MSS/TMB-H",
      "MSS/TMB-L"
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
fdr_to_significance <- function(fdr) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(fdr) ~ NA_character_,
    fdr <= 0.001 ~ "***",
    fdr <= 0.01 ~ "**",
    fdr <= 0.05 ~ "*",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  )
}
```

```{r}
plot_mirna_volcano <- function(
    result_table,
    dataset_name,
    contrast_title,
    output_file,
    flip_logfc = FALSE,
    label_n = 10
) {
  plot_df <- result_table %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column(
      "pre_miRNA"
    ) %>%
    tibble::as_tibble()

  if (flip_logfc) {
    plot_df$logFC <- -plot_df$logFC
  }

  plot_df <- plot_df %>%
    mutate(
      significant =
        !is.na(FDR) &
        FDR <= params$fdr_cutoff &
        abs(logFC) >= params$logfc_cutoff,

      direction = case_when(
        significant & logFC > 0 ~
          "Up in MSS/TMB-H",

        significant & logFC < 0 ~
          "Down in MSS/TMB-H",

        TRUE ~
          "Not significant"
      ),

      neglog10FDR = -log10(
        pmax(FDR, 1e-300)
      )
    )

  label_df <- plot_df %>%
    filter(significant) %>%
    arrange(
      FDR,
      desc(abs(logFC))
    ) %>%
    slice_head(
      n = label_n
    )

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_df,
    aes(
      x = logFC,
      y = neglog10FDR
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(
      aes(color = direction),
      alpha = 0.75,
      size = 1.6
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = c(
        -params$logfc_cutoff,
        params$logfc_cutoff
      ),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept =
        -log10(params$fdr_cutoff),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = label_df,
      aes(label = pre_miRNA),
      size = 3,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      box.padding = 0.35,
      point.padding = 0.2
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Up in MSS/TMB-H" =
          group_colors[["MSS/TMB-H"]],

        "Down in MSS/TMB-H" =
          group_colors[["MSI-H"]],

        "Not significant" =
          "grey80"
      ),
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        dataset_name,
        " pre-miRNA: ",
        contrast_title
      ),
      x = "log2 fold-change in MSS/TMB-H",
      y = expression(-log[10]("FDR")),
      color = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(
      base_size = 13
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      legend.position = "top"
    )

  ggsave(
    output_file,
    p,
    width = 6.5,
    height = 5.2,
    device = "svg"
  )

  invisible(p)
}
```

```{r}
run_mirna_analysis <- function(
    clinical_file,
    mirna_file,
    dataset_name,
    output_dir,
    figure_dir
) {
  fs::dir_create(output_dir)
  fs::dir_create(figure_dir)

  if (!file.exists(clinical_file)) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      " clinical file does not exist: ",
      clinical_file
    )
  }

  if (!file.exists(mirna_file)) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      " pre-miRNA count file does not exist: ",
      mirna_file
    )
  }

  
  
  

  clinical_data <- read.csv(
    clinical_file,
    header = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
    na.strings = c("NA", "")
  )

  required_columns <- c(
    "sample_submitter_id",
    "MSI_TMB"
  )

  missing_columns <- setdiff(
    required_columns,
    colnames(clinical_data)
  )

  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      " clinical file is missing columns: ",
      paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  if (anyDuplicated(
    clinical_data$sample_submitter_id
  )) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      " clinical data contain duplicated sample_submitter_id values."
    )
  }

  rownames(clinical_data) <-
    clinical_data$sample_submitter_id

  clinical_data$MSI_TMB <-
    standardize_msi_tmb(
      clinical_data$MSI_TMB
    )

  clinical_data <- clinical_data[
    !is.na(clinical_data$MSI_TMB),
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  
  
  

  mirna_counts <- as.matrix(
    read.csv(
      mirna_file,
      row.names = 1,
      check.names = FALSE
    )
  )

  storage.mode(mirna_counts) <-
    "numeric"

  if (anyNA(mirna_counts)) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      " pre-miRNA count matrix contains missing or non-numeric values."
    )
  }

  if (any(mirna_counts < 0)) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      " pre-miRNA count matrix contains negative values."
    )
  }

  if (anyDuplicated(rownames(mirna_counts))) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      " pre-miRNA count matrix contains duplicated row names."
    )
  }

  
  
  

  
  original_barcodes <- colnames(mirna_counts)

  
  sample_barcodes <- substr(
    original_barcodes,
    1,
    16
  )

  colnames(mirna_counts) <- sample_barcodes

  
  
  
  clinically_matched_columns <- colnames(mirna_counts) %in%
    rownames(clinical_data)

  mirna_counts <- mirna_counts[
    ,
    clinically_matched_columns,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  original_barcodes <- original_barcodes[
    clinically_matched_columns
  ]

  if (ncol(mirna_counts) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No common samples were found for ",
      dataset_name,
      "."
    )
  }

  
  
  sample_ids <- colnames(mirna_counts)
  library_sizes <- colSums(
    mirna_counts,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  candidate_table <- tibble::tibble(
    sample_submitter_id = sample_ids,
    original_aliquot_barcode = original_barcodes,
    library_size = as.numeric(library_sizes)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(sample_submitter_id) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      number_of_available_aliquots = dplyr::n(),
      selected = library_size == max(
        library_size,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      
      selected = selected &
        dplyr::row_number() ==
        min(dplyr::row_number()[selected])
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  selected_columns <- which(candidate_table$selected)

  if (anyDuplicated(sample_ids)) {
    message(
      dataset_name,
      ": duplicated aliquots remained after clinical matching. ",
      "Keeping one aliquot per sample using the largest library size."
    )
  }

  write.csv(
    candidate_table,
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      "pre_miRNA_aliquot_selection_audit.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  mirna_counts <- mirna_counts[
    ,
    selected_columns,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  original_barcodes <- original_barcodes[
    selected_columns
  ]

  if (anyDuplicated(colnames(mirna_counts))) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      ": duplicate sample barcodes remain after aliquot selection."
    )
  }

  
  
  

  common_samples <- intersect(
    colnames(mirna_counts),
    rownames(clinical_data)
  )

  if (length(common_samples) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No common samples were found for ",
      dataset_name,
      "."
    )
  }

  mirna_counts <- mirna_counts[
    ,
    common_samples,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  clinical_data <- clinical_data[
    common_samples,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  stopifnot(
    identical(
      colnames(mirna_counts),
      rownames(clinical_data)
    ),
    !anyDuplicated(
      colnames(mirna_counts)
    )
  )

  group_sizes <- table(
    clinical_data$MSI_TMB
  )

  if (any(group_sizes == 0)) {
    stop(
      dataset_name,
      " is missing at least one required MSI/TMB group."
    )
  }

  write.csv(
    data.frame(
      Dataset = dataset_name,
      Group = names(group_sizes),
      Number_of_samples =
        as.integer(group_sizes)
    ),
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      "sample_group_sizes.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  
  
  

  y <- edgeR::DGEList(
    counts = mirna_counts,
    group = clinical_data$MSI_TMB
  )

  keep <- edgeR::filterByExpr(
    y,
    group = clinical_data$MSI_TMB,
    min.count = params$min_count
  )

  y <- y[
    keep,
    ,
    keep.lib.sizes = FALSE
  ]

  if (nrow(y) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No pre-miRNAs passed expression filtering for ",
      dataset_name,
      "."
    )
  }

  y <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(
    y,
    method = "TMM"
  )

  design <- model.matrix(
    ~ 0 + clinical_data$MSI_TMB
  )

  colnames(design) <- c(
    "MSI_H",
    "MSS_TMB_H",
    "MSS_TMB_L"
  )

  y <- edgeR::estimateDisp(
    y,
    design,
    robust = TRUE
  )

  fit <- edgeR::glmQLFit(
    y,
    design,
    robust = TRUE
  )

  contrasts <- list(
    MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H =
      limma::makeContrasts(
        MSI_H - MSS_TMB_H,
        levels = design
      ),

    MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L =
      limma::makeContrasts(
        MSI_H - MSS_TMB_L,
        levels = design
      ),

    MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L =
      limma::makeContrasts(
        MSS_TMB_H - MSS_TMB_L,
        levels = design
      )
  )

  mirna_results <- lapply(
    contrasts,
    function(contrast_vector) {
      qlf <- edgeR::glmQLFTest(
        fit,
        contrast = contrast_vector
      )

      edgeR::topTags(
        qlf,
        n = Inf
      )$table
    }
  )

  
  
  

  significant_results <- list()

  for (contrast_name in names(mirna_results)) {
    full_table <- mirna_results[[
      contrast_name
    ]]

    write.csv(
      full_table,
      file.path(
        output_dir,
        paste0(
          contrast_name,
          ".csv"
        )
      )
    )

    significant_table <- full_table %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column(
        "pre_miRNA"
      ) %>%
      filter(
        !is.na(FDR),
        FDR <= params$fdr_cutoff,
        abs(logFC) >=
          params$logfc_cutoff
      ) %>%
      arrange(
        FDR,
        desc(abs(logFC))
      )

    significant_results[[
      contrast_name
    ]] <- significant_table

    write.csv(
      significant_table,
      file.path(
        output_dir,
        paste0(
          contrast_name,
          "_significant.csv"
        )
      ),
      row.names = FALSE
    )
  }

  
  
  

  volcano_mssh_vs_msih <-
    plot_mirna_volcano(
      result_table =
        mirna_results$MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H,

      dataset_name =
        dataset_name,

      contrast_title =
        "MSS/TMB-H vs MSI-H",

      output_file =
        file.path(
          figure_dir,
          paste0(
            "volcano_",
            dataset_name,
            "_pre_miRNA_MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSI_H.svg"
          )
        ),

      flip_logfc = TRUE,

      label_n =
        params$volcano_label_n
    )

  volcano_mssh_vs_mssl <-
    plot_mirna_volcano(
      result_table =
        mirna_results$MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L,

      dataset_name =
        dataset_name,

      contrast_title =
        "MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L",

      output_file =
        file.path(
          figure_dir,
          paste0(
            "volcano_",
            dataset_name,
            "_pre_miRNA_MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L.svg"
          )
        ),

      flip_logfc = FALSE,

      label_n =
        params$volcano_label_n
    )

  
  
  

  logcpm <- edgeR::cpm(
    y,
    log = TRUE,
    prior.count = 1
  )

  write.csv(
    logcpm,
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      "TMM_logCPM_matrix.csv"
    )
  )

  
  significant_mirnas <- unique(
    c(
      significant_results$
        MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H$
        pre_miRNA,

      significant_results$
        MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L$
        pre_miRNA
    )
  )

  significant_mirnas <- intersect(
    significant_mirnas,
    rownames(logcpm)
  )

  if (length(significant_mirnas) == 0) {
    warning(
      "No significant pre-miRNAs were found for ",
      dataset_name,
      " at FDR <= ",
      params$fdr_cutoff,
      " and |logFC| >= ",
      params$logfc_cutoff,
      ". Boxplots were not generated."
    )

    return(
      list(
        dataset = dataset_name,
        clinical_data = clinical_data,
        counts = mirna_counts,
        y = y,
        fit = fit,
        results = mirna_results,
        significant_results =
          significant_results,
        significant_mirnas =
          character(0),
        expression = tibble(),
        annotations = tibble(),
        boxplot = NULL,
        volcano_mssh_vs_msih =
          volcano_mssh_vs_msih,
        volcano_mssh_vs_mssl =
          volcano_mssh_vs_mssl
      )
    )
  }

  
  
  

  expression_df <- as.data.frame(
    logcpm[
      significant_mirnas,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]
  ) %>%
    rownames_to_column(
      "pre_miRNA"
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -pre_miRNA,
      names_to = "sample",
      values_to = "logCPM"
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      clinical_data %>%
        rownames_to_column(
          "sample"
        ) %>%
        select(
          sample,
          MSI_TMB
        ),
      by = "sample"
    )

  write.csv(
    expression_df,
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      "significant_pre_miRNA_expression_long.csv"
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  
  
  

  make_annotation <- function(
      result_table,
      group1,
      group2,
      contrast_label
  ) {
    result_table %>%
      rownames_to_column(
        "pre_miRNA"
      ) %>%
      filter(
        pre_miRNA %in%
          significant_mirnas
      ) %>%
      transmute(
        pre_miRNA,
        group1 = group1,
        group2 = group2,
        contrast = contrast_label,
        logFC,
        FDR,
        significance =
          fdr_to_significance(FDR)
      )
  }

  annotation_df <- bind_rows(
    make_annotation(
      result_table =
        mirna_results$
        MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H,

      group1 =
        "MSI-H",

      group2 =
        "MSS/TMB-H",

      contrast_label =
        "MSI-H vs MSS/TMB-H"
    ),

    make_annotation(
      result_table =
        mirna_results$
        MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L,

      group1 =
        "MSS/TMB-H",

      group2 =
        "MSS/TMB-L",

      contrast_label =
        "MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L"
    )
  )

  panel_ranges <- expression_df %>%
    group_by(
      pre_miRNA
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      panel_max = max(
        logCPM,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      panel_min = min(
        logCPM,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      panel_range = max(
        panel_max - panel_min,
        1
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  annotation_df <- annotation_df %>%
    left_join(
      panel_ranges,
      by = "pre_miRNA"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      comparison_number = case_when(
        group1 == "MSI-H" ~ 1,
        TRUE ~ 2
      ),

      y.position =
        panel_max +
        panel_range *
        (
          0.08 +
          0.16 * comparison_number
        )
    )

  write.csv(
    annotation_df,
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      paste0(
        dataset_name,
        "_pre_miRNA_significance_annotations.csv"
      )
    ),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  
  
  

  boxplot_object <- ggplot(
    expression_df,
    aes(
      x = MSI_TMB,
      y = logCPM,
      fill = MSI_TMB
    )
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.68,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      linewidth = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.13,
      size = 0.75,
      alpha = 0.45
    ) +
    ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
      annotation_df,
      label = "significance",
      xmin = "group1",
      xmax = "group2",
      y.position = "y.position",
      tip.length = 0.01,
      bracket.size = 0.3,
      size = 3,
      hide.ns = TRUE
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ pre_miRNA,
      scales = "free_y",
      nrow = 1
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = group_colors,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(
        mult = c(
          0.05,
          0.30
        )
      )
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        dataset_name,
        " pre-miRNA expression"
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Significant in at least one MSS/TMB-H contrast; ",
        "brackets show edgeR FDR"
      ),
      x = NULL,
      y = "TMM-normalized logCPM",
      fill = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(
      base_size = 11
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      strip.background = element_rect(
        fill = "white",
        color = "black",
        linewidth = 0.4
      ),
      strip.text = element_text(
        face = "bold"
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(
        0.15,
        "lines"
      )
    )

  boxplot_file <- file.path(
    figure_dir,
    paste0(
      "pre_miRNA_expression_boxplots_",
      dataset_name,
      ".svg"
    )
  )

  ggsave(
    boxplot_file,
    boxplot_object,
    width = max(
      8,
      length(significant_mirnas) *
        1.9
    ),
    height = 5,
    device = "svg",
    limitsize = FALSE
  )

  
  
  

  export_full <- bind_rows(
    lapply(
      names(mirna_results),
      function(contrast_name) {
        mirna_results[[contrast_name]] %>%
          rownames_to_column(
            "pre_miRNA"
          ) %>%
          mutate(
            Dataset = dataset_name,
            Contrast = contrast_name,
            .before = 1
          )
      }
    )
  )

  export_significant <- export_full %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(FDR),
      FDR <= params$fdr_cutoff,
      abs(logFC) >=
        params$logfc_cutoff
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      Contrast,
      FDR,
      desc(abs(logFC))
    )

  summary_counts <- export_significant %>%
    mutate(
      Direction = case_when(
        logFC > 0 ~
          "Up in first contrast group",

        logFC < 0 ~
          "Down in first contrast group",

        TRUE ~
          "No change"
      )
    ) %>%
    count(
      Contrast,
      Direction,
      name = "Number_of_pre_miRNAs"
    )

  workbook_file <- file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(
      dataset_name,
      "_pre_miRNA_DE_results.xlsx"
    )
  )

  workbook <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()

  openxlsx::addWorksheet(
    workbook,
    "All_DE_results"
  )

  openxlsx::writeData(
    workbook,
    "All_DE_results",
    export_full
  )

  openxlsx::addWorksheet(
    workbook,
    "Significant_DE"
  )

  openxlsx::writeData(
    workbook,
    "Significant_DE",
    export_significant
  )

  openxlsx::addWorksheet(
    workbook,
    "Significance_annotations"
  )

  openxlsx::writeData(
    workbook,
    "Significance_annotations",
    annotation_df
  )

  openxlsx::addWorksheet(
    workbook,
    "Summary_counts"
  )

  openxlsx::writeData(
    workbook,
    "Summary_counts",
    summary_counts
  )

  for (sheet_name in names(workbook)) {
    openxlsx::freezePane(
      workbook,
      sheet_name,
      firstRow = TRUE
    )

    openxlsx::setColWidths(
      workbook,
      sheet_name,
      cols = 1:30,
      widths = "auto"
    )
  }

  openxlsx::saveWorkbook(
    workbook,
    workbook_file,
    overwrite = TRUE
  )

  list(
    dataset = dataset_name,
    clinical_data = clinical_data,
    counts = mirna_counts,
    y = y,
    fit = fit,
    results = mirna_results,
    significant_results =
      significant_results,
    significant_mirnas =
      significant_mirnas,
    expression = expression_df,
    annotations = annotation_df,
    boxplot = boxplot_object,
    volcano_mssh_vs_msih =
      volcano_mssh_vs_msih,
    volcano_mssh_vs_mssl =
      volcano_mssh_vs_mssl,
    workbook = workbook_file
  )
}
```

```{r}
extract_mssh_direction <- function(
    result_table,
    comparison
) {
  result_table %>%
    rownames_to_column(
      "pre_miRNA"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      MSS_TMB_H_logFC = case_when(
        comparison ==
          "MSS/TMB-H vs MSI-H" ~
          -logFC,

        comparison ==
          "MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L" ~
          logFC,

        TRUE ~
          NA_real_
      ),

      significant =
        !is.na(FDR) &
        FDR <= params$fdr_cutoff &
        abs(MSS_TMB_H_logFC) >=
          params$logfc_cutoff,

      direction = case_when(
        significant &
        MSS_TMB_H_logFC > 0 ~
          "Up in MSS/TMB-H",

        significant &
        MSS_TMB_H_logFC < 0 ~
          "Down in MSS/TMB-H",

        TRUE ~
          "Not significant"
      ),

      Comparison = comparison
    )
}

crc_mssh_vs_msih <-
  extract_mssh_direction(
    crc_analysis$results$
      MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H,
    "MSS/TMB-H vs MSI-H"
  )

crc_mssh_vs_mssl <-
  extract_mssh_direction(
    crc_analysis$results$
      MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L,
    "MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L"
  )

ucec_mssh_vs_msih <-
  extract_mssh_direction(
    ucec_analysis$results$
      MSI_H_vs_MSS_TMB_H,
    "MSS/TMB-H vs MSI-H"
  )

ucec_mssh_vs_mssl <-
  extract_mssh_direction(
    ucec_analysis$results$
      MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L,
    "MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L"
  )

overlap_summary <- tibble(
  Comparison = c(
    "MSS/TMB-H vs MSI-H",
    "MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L"
  ),

  CRC_significant = c(
    sum(
      crc_mssh_vs_msih$significant
    ),
    sum(
      crc_mssh_vs_mssl$significant
    )
  ),

  UCEC_significant = c(
    sum(
      ucec_mssh_vs_msih$significant
    ),
    sum(
      ucec_mssh_vs_mssl$significant
    )
  ),

  Shared_significant = c(
    length(
      intersect(
        crc_mssh_vs_msih$
          pre_miRNA[
            crc_mssh_vs_msih$
              significant
          ],

        ucec_mssh_vs_msih$
          pre_miRNA[
            ucec_mssh_vs_msih$
              significant
          ]
      )
    ),

    length(
      intersect(
        crc_mssh_vs_mssl$
          pre_miRNA[
            crc_mssh_vs_mssl$
              significant
          ],

        ucec_mssh_vs_mssl$
          pre_miRNA[
            ucec_mssh_vs_mssl$
              significant
          ]
      )
    )
  )
)

write.csv(
  overlap_summary,
  file.path(
    params$output_root,
    "CRC_UCEC_significant_pre_miRNA_overlap_summary.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

knitr::kable(
  overlap_summary,
  caption = "Overlap of significant pre-miRNAs between CRC and UCEC."
)
```

```{r}
create_shared_table <- function(
    crc_table,
    ucec_table,
    comparison_name
) {
  crc_sig <- crc_table %>%
    filter(significant) %>%
    select(
      pre_miRNA,
      CRC_logFC =
        MSS_TMB_H_logFC,
      CRC_FDR = FDR,
      CRC_direction =
        direction
    )

  ucec_sig <- ucec_table %>%
    filter(significant) %>%
    select(
      pre_miRNA,
      UCEC_logFC =
        MSS_TMB_H_logFC,
      UCEC_FDR = FDR,
      UCEC_direction =
        direction
    )

  inner_join(
    crc_sig,
    ucec_sig,
    by = "pre_miRNA"
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Comparison =
        comparison_name,

      Direction_consistent =
        CRC_direction ==
        UCEC_direction,

      .before = 1
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(Direction_consistent),
      CRC_FDR,
      UCEC_FDR
    )
}

shared_msih <- create_shared_table(
  crc_mssh_vs_msih,
  ucec_mssh_vs_msih,
  "MSS/TMB-H vs MSI-H"
)

shared_mssl <- create_shared_table(
  crc_mssh_vs_mssl,
  ucec_mssh_vs_mssl,
  "MSS/TMB-H vs MSS/TMB-L"
)

write.csv(
  shared_msih,
  file.path(
    params$output_root,
    "shared_pre_miRNAs_MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSI_H_CRC_UCEC.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  shared_mssl,
  file.path(
    params$output_root,
    "shared_pre_miRNAs_MSS_TMB_H_vs_MSS_TMB_L_CRC_UCEC.csv"
  ),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
